RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts.

An all-male panel is worth querying as a procedural concern, but it does not establish sex discrimination. Depending on the jurisdiction, panel-composition rules may apply. Your qualifications and the announcement alone don’t establish who best met the selection criteria.

Follow up in writing: request the assessment criteria, your scores, the reasons for selecting the successful candidate, and whether panel-composition requirements were followed. Keep records.

Two weeks without a response does not itself indicate bias. Check applicable response and complaint deadlines now; don’t assume waiting for reasons extends them. Your union or an equality body can advise on whether a formal challenge is warranted.
